title: Unforgettable Briny Ukrainian Sugar Snap Peas Skewers
description: A show-off Ukrainian dish featuring sugar snap peas, this recipe is a plant-based friendly option that is sure to impress, with a briny flavor and a unique cooking method using ttukbaegi earthenware on a cedar plank.
instructions: Preheat the ttukbaegi earthenware to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, apple cider vinegar, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and dried dill weed.
Add the sugar snap peas to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated sugar snap peas onto skewers, leaving a small space between each pea.
Place the skewers on the preheated cedar plank and cook for 10 minutes, or until the peas are tender.
Brush the peas with lemon juice and water during the last 2 minutes of cooking.
Remove the skewers from the heat and let cool for a few minutes.
Serve the skewers on the cedar plank, garnished with additional dried dill weed if desired.
